Cristiano Ronaldo's sister criticizes Portuguese people

Katia Aveiro, the sister of footballer Cristiano Ronaldo, has criticized the Portuguese people in a social media post, accusing them of a "lack of respect." Aveiro's comments suggest that her brother has "QUIT Portugal," though this is not explicitly stated as fact by the coverage.
